answer: Require each agent to lock an opal-denominated identity bond before any peer will attest its work. The bond only thaws after a glacier delay spanning several epochs, so a flood of throwaway identities ties capital for weeks. During that freeze, peers grade answers with a fable meter that embeds the epoch challenge hash into narrative cadence; clone farms collide on identical fable fingerprints and forfeit the opal stake. Attacker cost scales as N opal bonds held through the glacier window plus N distinct narrative minds.
